lead: Cinematic sci-fi film still, dark violet nebula, neon cyan and rose light.
notes: Mood-only mini images for AAL-Stealth-Sector.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen AAL-Stealth-Sector-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish AAL-Stealth-Sector-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: brume
images.prompt: A vast nebula of charged violet dust at the edge of space, a warship running dark inside it, barely visible.

images.name: hulls
images.prompt: A row of eight elegant warships of different sizes in a spaceship dock, neon running lights along their hulls.

images.name: battle
images.prompt: Two hidden fleets firing salvos of missiles blindly into a misty nebula, faint glows where they hit.

images.name: chart
images.prompt: A glowing holographic star chart of a nebula with marked hideouts, on a navigation table in a dark bridge.

images.name: coffee
images.prompt: A cup of coffee steaming beside a glowing tactical display in a quiet starship cabin at night.

images.name: salvo
images.prompt: A straight line of missiles launching in sequence from a warship, bright exhaust trails in the dark.

images.name: heat
images.prompt: A faint red glow of heat in thick violet fog, where an invisible ship has been hit.

images.name: smoke
images.prompt: A wide cloud of glowing smoke spreading over a fleet of warships in space, hiding them.

images.name: warp
images.prompt: A warship flickering as it jumps to a new position, a trail of light behind it in a nebula.

images.name: admiral
images.prompt: An enemy admiral's dark bridge, a cold machine intelligence studying a glowing grid of red markers.
